output: The proportion of respondents who mentioned that requirements in ML-enabled system projects are not documented at all is approximately 29.71%, with a 95% confidence interval of [24.28%, 35.14%]. This suggests that a significant proportion of respondents believe that requirements in ML-enabled system projects are not documented at all. The context of the hypothesis is the documentation practices in ML-enabled system projects. The variable chosen is the `Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented` column, which indicates whether requirements are not documented at all. The relationship between the variable and the proportion of respondents is that a higher proportion of respondents indicated that requirements are not documented at all, which is statistically significant with a 95% confidence interval of [24.28%, 35.14%].
